title: Star Premium sitao: Characteristics
metaDescription: Star Premium sitao is a sitao variety from Allied Botanical. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Star Premium is a sitao variety, also sold or known as Star Premium pole sitao. It is not on the NSIC registry, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Allied Botanical.

heroImage.alt: A farmer watering vegetable beds in Pulilan, Bulacan, the kind of farm where Star Premium sitao is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Star Premium pole sitao, this is the same sitao. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [sitao variety finder](/crop-varieties/sitao), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for legumes](/land-preparation/legume-land-preparation).
Key facts about Star Premium sitao

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources
rows: Days to harvest, per the seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

The registry gives no day count or trial yield for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit sitao fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** 40 to 45 days after sowing.
**Fruit:** Dark green pods, very long at 80 to 85 cm.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: in Allied Botanical's current yardlong bean list, company listing is the only evidence found. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual sitao on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Star Premium sitao

Pole sitao climbs a trellis and bears for weeks, while bush sitao needs no trellis and comes in at once. Pick long, dark green pods that snap cleanly, and a variety rated against the bean fly and rust if you can. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Star Premium pole sitao the same as Star Premium?
items.a: Yes. Star Premium pole sitao is another name for Star Premium. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Star Premium?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
